newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gainers and losers.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gainers and losers.

text.p: NWE oil products were divided on Wednesday with both gainers and losers.
Gas oil slipped 75 cents on futures. German demand boosted heating oil cargo premiums but lack of buying interest hit those for Russians.
Naphtha ended slightly higher on crude's strength and continued interest to ship supplies to the U.S.

Gasoline ended modestly higher as up to 750,000 tonnes were seen leaving Europe for the U.S. this month due to an attractive arbitrage and ample NWE supplies. Fuel barges slipped $1, but cargoes remained steady.-- London newsroom +44 171 542 7646
